import_errors.carracing: ImportError: CarRacing-v3 cannot be reset and rendered: DependencyNotInstalled: Box2D is not installed, you can install it by run `pip install swig` followed by `pip install "gymnasium[box2d]"`. import_errors.fetch: ImportError: the Fetch family renders its 18 robot meshes with mujoco_warp's batch raytracer, which this interpreter cannot run: missing warp, mujoco_warp; mujoco is 3.12.0 and mujoco_warp requires >= 3.11. The envs were measured in /mnt/vast/home/randall.balestriero/venvs/se-fetch, built with `python -m venv --system-site-packages` so that only mujoco is shadowed and gymnasium, gymnasium-robotics, torch, triton and scipy stay shared. See docs/research/fetch.md
import_errors.griddly: ImportError: griddly is not importable (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'griddly'). The atlas is composed of tiles griddly's own Vulkan renderer draws, so there is no degraded mode. `pip install griddly==1.6.7` — the only release, from 2023-03-15; upstream's last commit is 2024-04-07 and there is no successor.
import_errors.humanoidbench: ImportError: the HumanoidBench family is measured and complete on fidelity (17 cells, VISUAL tier, mean 2.6-8.4/255, SSIM 0.845-0.931, 437x the official renderer at batch 64) but is NOT registered by default: mujoco_warp's batched render is not bit-reproducible inside a long conformance session, so 2-3 of ~660 tests fail every run on test_determinism and test_frame_i_is_independent_of_batch_size, by 1-2/255, on a different cell each time. Set STABLE_ENVS_HUMANOIDBENCH=1 to register it anyway. See docs/research/humanoidbench.md
import_errors.jumanji: ImportError: the Jumanji family builds its per-pixel atlas by CALLING the official matplotlib viewer, so it cannot render without the reference package: missing jumanji, jax, matplotlib. The envs were measured in /mnt/vast/home/randall.balestriero/venvs/se-jumanji, built with a CLEAN `python -m venv` — a --system-site-packages venv breaks jax's CUDA plugin discovery. See docs/research/jumanji.md
import_errors.lunarlander: ImportError: LunarLander-v3 cannot be reset and rendered: DependencyNotInstalled: Box2D is not installed, you can install it by run `pip install swig` followed by `pip install "gymnasium[box2d]"`. This env needs BOTH `box2d-py` (for the simulator that produces its states) and `pygame` (for the reference renderer parity is measured against); `pip install swig` then `pip install "gymnasium[box2d]"`.
import_errors.metaworld: ImportError: the Meta-World family ray-casts the Sawyer's meshes with mujoco_warp's batch raytracer, which this interpreter cannot run: missing metaworld, warp, mujoco_warp; mujoco is 3.12.0 and mujoco_warp requires >= 3.11 (metaworld itself pins mujoco==3.3.0, which is why it is installed with --no-deps). import_errors.overcooked: ImportError: jaxmarl is not importable (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'jaxmarl'). import_errors.pgx: ImportError: the PGX family needs pgx (which brings jax), resvg_py and Pillow, and this interpreter cannot provide them: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pgx'. import_errors.robocasa: ImportError: the RoboCasa family renders its kitchens with mujoco_warp's batch raytracer, which this interpreter cannot run: missing warp, mujoco_warp; mujoco is 3.12.0 and mujoco_warp requires >= 3.11. PFRocketLanding.rejudge_rule: scratch/step4/certify.py: a not_applicable mandatory check is a property the env does not have, never a skipped check; PARTIAL is reserved for registered_default_coverage == 'partial'

what_this_is: Gate A for the seven Step-7 cells on their committed Step-7 corpora, at the registered default size, through examples/fidelity_step4.measure. No threshold is applied here beyond the mandatory group's own == 0 contract; scratch/step4/certify.py owns the rest at the Step-8 freeze.
